dialogues.speaker: Mikoshi Genjirou
dialogues.text: Hello! If you're here on government business, please tell me who you are, why you are here, and give me the delivery deadline.

dialogues.speaker: Mikoshi Genjirou
dialogues.text: If you're not here for business, then I'm sorry, but I don't have time for chitchat.

dialogues.speaker: Mikoshi Genjirou
dialogues.text: I'm Mikoshi Genjirou, a government official affiliated with the Tenryou Commission.

dialogues.speaker: Mikoshi Genjirou
dialogues.text: What... So you are not here to take over my shift? Then please leave me alone.

dialogues.speaker: Mikoshi Genjirou
dialogues.text: An elite like me is always either hard at work or honing my skills. This is a world in which only the best survive, after all. Only the most excellent will stick around.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are your thoughts about your work?

dialogues.speaker: Mikoshi Genjirou
dialogues.text: I believe that everyone should take their own job seriously. This is the only way to keep the whole system functioning properly.

dialogues.speaker: Mikoshi Genjirou
dialogues.text: Like those people from the army. They still haven't been able to defeat Sangonomiya after such a long time. A laughable lot!

dialogues.speaker: Mikoshi Genjirou
dialogues.text: From what I heard, the Sangonomiya troops have appointed some "dog" as their commander... If that's true, then that Kujou Sara really is good for nothing!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is Mikoshi Genichirou your elder brother?

dialogues.speaker: Mikoshi Genjirou
dialogues.text: Tsk... That incompetent loser. He's content with just owning a small shop. He is still the same after all these years. So sluggish.

dialogues.speaker: Mikoshi Genjirou
dialogues.text: I knew that he wouldn't accomplish anything ever since he was little. And as expected, the future of the Mikoshi clan is still mine to uphold.
